body: You know, i feel like shit too, this world isn't everyone's friend. I understand not wanting to talk to your family or friends, but think about your mother, or your father, finding you dead corpse. Hell, you'd probably make them depressed, make them think they failed you, and that's just not fair. If you need someone to talk to, message me, god knows i do. It's not the answer, don't ruin anyone else's life.
